race.comment: THROW IT BACK (1) resumes from a spell without any public trial, after showing talent in 4 starts as a 3YO late last season. He has a good draw, steps out in a suitable race, and is good enough to take this out. SPOILT ROTTEN (5) broke through for an overdue maiden win here 2 weeks ago on soft ground and did it in style by nearly 2 lengths. This is not a huge leap in class, and now that the penny has dropped, he can go on with the job. MISTER MIGHTY (6) ran on to late when resuming at the Sunshine Coast nearly a month ago when a slow start put paid to his chances. He is worth another chance. SKELDERGATE (2) made progress through a winter campaign, and is resuming off a short spell over a trip short of his best. He will be hitting the line hard, and is capable of a top 4 finish. RUMBLE TOWN (10) has been thereabouts this season, and he gets Ryan Wiggins in the saddle for the first time. Don't underestimate him.
